headline: UNDERTEXT fuses 34 public observations across archive and board readings
dek: The fusion remaps already-published Wayback, Weibo-board and DDTI records onto one observation schema without inventing a live deletion round.

claims.statement: The current fusion contains 34 observations reconstructed from committed public readings.

method.summary: Offline fusion of committed readings through divergence_to_observation and china_observation.enrich_observation. Optional live surfaces require UNDERTEXT_LIVE_SURFACES=1 and an injected or operator fetch.

limitations: Fusion inherits the limits of its inputs; archive-status rows are not relabelled as deletions, and optional Wikipedia live surfaces stay gated.
